newsitem.title: POLAND: Trader Bartimpex tops Polish private firms ranking.
newsitem.headline: Trader Bartimpex tops Polish private firms ranking.

text.p: Trading company Bartimpex SA heads a ranking of Polish private unlisted firms prepared by Businessman Magazine, with a market value of 1.2 billion zlotys, the monthly said on Friday.

The ranking, named "The List of 100," lists the firms in terms of their market value, which was estimated according to their book value, profits and revenues, the magazine's editor-in-chief Jan Bazyl Lipszyc told a news conference.

Bartimpex, owned by private investor Aleksander Gudzowaty and specialising in barter trade with Russia, ranked above the Stocznia Szczecinska shipyard and publisher Agora-Gazeta, with market value of one billion zloty and 554 million zloty respectively.
By way of comparison, the magazine said it estimated the market value of listed industrial and trading conglomerate Elektrim at 2.1 billion zlotys.
Lipszyc said the magazine would publish similar rankings in subsequent years.
